name: blinking stars effect
author: WeDevlops.com

sections.description:
The Blinking Stars plugin for WordPress adds an animated effect of blinking stars with different colors (pro version only) to your website, enhancing its visual appeal

Dynamic Visuals: This plugin adds an animated effect of blinking stars to your wordpress website, enhancing its aesthetic appeal.

Responsive Design: The animation works seamlessly across all devices, ensuring a consistent visual experience on desktops, tablets, and smartphones.

Versatile Use: Perfect for adding a magical touch to your site, celebrating special events, or simply making your website more engaging.

Compatibility: Fully tested and operational on wordpress versions 6.x and works with all wordpress templates.

Easy Setup: Quick to install and configure, enabling you to add the blinking stars effect to your site with minimal effort.

This module is perfect for adding a whimsical and dynamic effect to your wordpress site. By the animation, you can create a unique and captivating circles field that enhances the overall user experience and keeps visitors engaged.

FOR PRO VERSION:

Customizable Animation: You can control the speed of the blinking animation and the delay between each star’s appearance through the WordPress admin panel. This allows you to create a unique and captivating star field1.

Random Color Generation: Each star is assigned a random color, creating a vibrant and lively display that captures visitors’ attention.

Customizable Colors: Simply add the colors you wanted to show on the backend settings.

Easy Setup: With backend settings for Star Colors, Blinking Animation Speed and Star Appearance Delay.
